art.title: POV: your first sushi counter in Japan

gags: freeze snap inside a moving clip (chef and customers freeze staring at the hands piling ginger on the nigiri, steam and lanterns keep moving)
WRONG WAY / RIGHT WAY verdict stamps (overlays on moving footage)
silence-to-shout (male chef, male voice: それは口直しだよ！ / That's a palate cleanser!)
the wait (chef slices fish and customers eat while the POV fist waits)
punchline: the ginger resets your mouth, not your sushi.
pdca.hook: You pile pink ginger on your sushi. The chef freezes.
